n: Single Unit Front Load Washtower™ With Center Control™ 4.5 Cu. Ft. Washer And 7.4 Cu. Ft. Gas Dryer
desc: Full-size and fully featured, with the washer on the bottom and dryer on top, the sleek single unit LG WashTower takes up half the space, giving you room to add a sink, a folding table or whatever you like. Unlike conventional stacked laundry pairs, LG’s exclusive Center Control panel is perfectly positioned with both washer and dryer controls at just the right height for your convenience.
hl: Backed by a 10-year limited warranty, the LG Direct Drive Motor delivers quiet peace of mind with every load.
Sleek, scratch-resistant tempered glass doors are complemented by a matte black rim.
